description: Post-freeze study-universe registry for hierarchical pan-cancer analyses. It preserves the 33-cancer TCGA reference, classifies every external study manifest as hierarchical_active, catalog_only or inactive, and records server-readable capabilities and exclusion reasons. It does not modify the publication-frozen v1 registry or manuscript evidence.

tcga_reference.note: TCGA cancer definitions remain resolved from cancer_types.json; external-only disease entities never increase the 33-cancer reference.

release_clusters.evidence: The 16 Choueiri phase-I patients are the CheckMate-009 subset represented inside the larger 181-patient nivolumab release.
Fifty-two of the 60 ICART1-2 participants reconcile to the broader ICART1 source cohort; the releases are not independent.
Both releases derive from the Australian Pancreatic Cancer Genome Initiative. The QCMG release is an explicitly non-overlapping supplement but is not treated as an independent study.

overlap_relations.evidence: All 16 Choueiri patients are the CheckMate-009 subset included in the promoted CheckMate biomarker resource.
Fifty-two participants overlap; only eight ICART1-2 participants are an expansion.
The retained 18 QCMG donors do not overlap the 66 PACA-AU donors, but both releases belong to APGI and must not be counted as independent studies.

partition_groups.evidence: Cancer-specific, non-overlapping subsets of the POG570 precision-oncology program; retained as separate cancer universes but linked to one parent study.
GBM and LGG are disjoint disease filters; the pinned mRNAseq_325 and mRNAseq_693 releases share no CGGA identifiers or complete clinical fingerprints.
Primary grade-IV and primary grade-II/III filters from GLASS are mutually exclusive; recurrent and TCGA-labelled samples are excluded.
Mutually exclusive adenocarcinoma and squamous-cell histology filters from GSE103584.
Mutually exclusive LUAD and LUSC histology-code filters from GSE81089.
Mutually exclusive colon and rectal primary-site partitions from GSE192667.
Prespecified independent discovery and validation cohorts released in the same GEO series.
Non-overlapping prospective AZA-HiDAC-Mito and historical HiDAC-Mito patient arms from GSE152431.
Acral and sun-exposed subcohorts share the GEO series but no patients.
Mutually exclusive chromophobe and papillary renal-cancer partitions from the same public article release.

preflight_policy.capability_rule: Only hierarchical_active universes may enter effect estimation; catalog_only and inactive universes remain visible with explicit reasons.
